title: Industrial PBGA, derivative package
authored_by: hand-written expectation, not a snapshot of generator output
rationale: Industrial mission profile: TC at the -55/+125 C class condition for 1000 cycles and HTSL 1000 h at 150 C - a step above the consumer defaults, a step below the automotive suite.

Derivative on a NON-automotive part: 1 assembly lot plus a written similarity justification. Emitting 3 lots here is not wrong on safety grounds but it means the generator ignored the novelty input, which is the thing this case tests.
MSL 3 precon soak is 30 C / 60 %RH for 192 h - the mid-table soak, matched to the 168 h floor life the factory is actually managing.

Wire-bond on an organic substrate: wire pull, ball-bond shear and die shear stay in scope, and solder BALL shear (JESD22-B117) is additionally required because the second-level interconnect is a ball array.
Area array on a 23 mm organic body: board-level thermal cycling and shadow-moire warpage are REQUIRED rows - a body this size is exactly where dynamic warpage causes head-in-pillow.
Cabinet-mounted with no drop exposure and no automotive requirement: board-level drop, power temperature cycling and the automotive mechanical suite must all be absent.
